prompt: A company manufactures a batch of 1200 items. 15% of the items are found to be defective. The non-defective items are sold at a price of $30 each. The defective items are repaired at a cost of $8 per item and then sold at a reduced price of $20 each. The initial manufacturing cost for *each* item produced (including those that later prove defective) is $15. What is the company's net profit or loss from this batch of items?
